task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagent progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the text-only harness vision and image generation.","id":"gh:1336068061","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-crew","slug":"ZSeven-W/dsh-crew","topics":["ai-agents","claude-code","codex","coding-agent","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","mcp","multimodal","orchestration","plugin","subagent","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex — native subagen"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"t progress, in-host worker sessions with per-tier presets, and a multimodal bridge that lends the te"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"xt-only harness vision and image generation."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"DSH Crew"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin: dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok"},{"id":"p3s2","text":", without giving up the host's native subagent UI."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Native Progress UI • Tier Policy & Escalation • Dispatch Guardrails • Jobs Board • In-Host DSH Sessi"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ons • Vision & Image Gen (Native-First) • One-Click Install"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"npm: @zseven-w/dsh-crew · Current plugin release: 0.1.0-rc.11 · Tested with DSH 0.1.1-rc.1"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Tü"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"rkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"The DSH Crew settings page — host integrations, dispatch policy, execution and the multimodal bridge"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why DSH Crew"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"DSH Crew is a plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — an open-source agent harness. It makes DSH agents "},{"id":"p9s2","text":"dispatchable from Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and Grok: the orchestrator keeps its own model, th"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"e work runs on a real DSH agent with that harness's tools, sandbox, presets and session history, and"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" the host still shows it as a native subagent with live progress."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"What runs the work is a DSH agent, not a bare model call. Tiers (`flash` / `pro`) select how much ca"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"pability that agent gets from the harness's configured roster — DeepSeek V4 Flash and V4 Pro today —"},{"id":"p10s3","text":" so a change of model in DSH needs no change here."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 🧵 Native Progress UI"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Workers appear as regular subagents in Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity / Grok — dispatch count, ru"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"nning step, tool calls and token usage all show up in the host's own task panel, plus a claude-hud s"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"tatusline segment: `⚙dsh 1▶pro 2m14s 21.7k/606 ✓3`."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 🎚️ Tier Policy and Escalation"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`flash` for mechanical work, `pro` for reasoning, `effort` from `off` to `max`. `tier_policy` can cl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"amp every dispatch to one tier at the tool layer, and `escalate_on_failure` retries a failed flash r"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"un once on pro — based on evidence, not on guessing difficulty up front."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 🏛️ In-Host DSH Sessions"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"With the bundle installed in a DSH profile, each worker is a first-class DSH session: visible in the"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" Web UI, grouped by working directory, mounted with the Agent preset you choose per tier. Without DS"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"H running, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still wo"},{"id":"p16s4","text":"unning, dispatch falls back to a standalone DSH runtime, so CI and headless environments still work."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 👁️ Vision and Image Generation"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"DSH's models are text-only. `describe_image` now prefers DeepSeek's own VL model (`deepseek-v4-flash"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"-vision-exp`) whenever a key is available, then falls back to the CLIs you already have — Claude, Co"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"dex, Grok, Antigravity — or any OpenAI-compatible API you configure. `generate_image` borrows the sa"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"me CLIs' brush. Pasted images stay visible in the conversation and reach the model as text."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### 🛡️ Dispatch Guardrails"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Every dispatch is checked before anything spawns. Worker→worker nesting is capped at origin-chain de"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"pth 3 and cycles are refused; a second worker on a workspace another job already holds is refused wi"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"th the holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"holder's info — never silently queued. Refusals are readable errors: wait or re-scope, don't bypass."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"### 📋 Jobs Board"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The DSH Crew panel doubles as a jobs board: every worker job — running or finished — is listed with "},{"id":"p22s2","text":"tier, effort, live progress and tokens, held workspaces show their holders, and a job that vanishes "},{"id":"p22s3","text":"mid-flight (e.g. a hub restart) is surfaced as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"### 🔌 Custom Providers"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Bring your own endpoint (Base URL + API key + models) or a local command template. Each provider has"},{"id":"p24s2","text":" a connectivity test that checks reachability and auth, then makes one real vision call so you find "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"out now, not mid-task."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 📦 One-Click Install"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The settings page installs and updates the Claude Code plugin, the Codex role files and the Antigrav"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ity / Grok agents, skills and commands for you — marketplace registration, permission allowlist, HUD"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" wiring, absolute paths rendered for this machine — and restores them just as easily. Every settings"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" file is backed up first."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## One run, two views"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Dispatch fans out. Below, eighteen workers translate this README in parallel: the host counts them a"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"s its own subagents, while the harness runs them as real sessions."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"Claude Code sees dsh-crew workers as native subagents, with a statusline segment tracking running ti"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"ers, elapsed time and tokens."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"The DSH Crew panel sees the same run from the harness side: which host dispatched each job, its tier"},{"id":"p32s2","text":" and effort, live progress and token usage."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"The panel is also the jobs board: running and finished jobs stay listed with tier, progress and toke"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"ns, held workspaces name their holders, and a job that vanishes mid-flight (a hub restart) surfaces "},{"id":"p33s3","text":"as an orphan ghost instead of disappearing silently."},{"id":"p34s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"Install into a DSH profile from npm:"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"Or, for local development straight from the source tree:"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"### Caveats"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"- agy runs workers with **full approval** (`--dangerously-skip-permissions` + accept-edits): agy 1.1"},{"id":"p41s2","text":".16 has no workspace-scoped permission mode, so a headless worker must auto-approve tool requests."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"Uninstall: `node src/install/cli.mjs uninstall-agy`"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"### Caveats"},{"id":"p44s1","text":"- By security design, grok does not start repo-level MCP servers in untrusted project directories (`"},{"id":"p44s2","text":"grok mcp doctor` reports \"folder untrusted\"); a global install is unaffected — change directory or p"},{"id":"p44s3","text":"ass `--trust`.\n- grok workers run with `bypassPermissions` (always-approve, as the grok docs recomme"},{"id":"p44s4","text":"nd for headless automation); deny rules and hooks still apply."},{"id":"p45s1","text":"Uninstall: `node src/install/cli.mjs uninstall-grok`"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## Solution selection and limitations"}],"truncated":true}
